_tier: Tier A: map IDs, widths, original_life and the three bosses from v83 Map.wz / Mob.wz. Tier C: region, map order and pool rules (spec #449 C10, ticket #472, progression step 15), the 900 s duration and every pacing value, which copy Sleepywood's keyframe numbers (rate, max_alive, hp, speed), bursts, elites, exp_mult and hard_cap exactly (Sleepywood carries no post_duration_slope). Only the pools differ, and there is no opening_ramp: level_scale takes its place. Keyframes from 300 s carry no pool because map 1 picks only keyframes with t < 300 (maps 2 and 3 use explicit pools).
name: Ludibrium Clocktower
_bosses: Tier C: owner schedule (Gatekeeper, Thanatos, Papulatus; spec #449); hp_mult, dmg_mult, attack_dmg_mult and final_form_hp_mult are the first draft of game/tools/level_scale_draft.gd (--step=15 --stage=clocktower), not tuned. 8 s per-attack cadence as every boss. Canonical attacks, timing, stats and elements stay in Mob.wz. All bosses and reward choices must finish to clear.
_maps: Tier C: owner map order and pool rules, spec #449. Each boss time is relative to map entry. The Path of Time maps themselves are climbing towers 2265-2429 px high and are rejected; the three passages are flat (Warped Passage 2995 px, Forgotten Passage 2995, Deep Inside the Clocktower 4143) and hold almost no ordinary monsters (Gatekeeper x2, Thanatos x2, none), so every map has an explicit pool of the Clocktower's real ordinary monsters, rising in level: the lower Path of Time's Ghost Pirate (Lv83), Death Teddy (85) and Dual Ghost Pirate (87) on map 1 (keyframe pools of the curve); Master Death Teddy (89), Spirit Viking (93) and Phantom Watch (95) on map 2; Gigantic Spirit Viking (98) and Grim Phantom Watch (99) on map 3. Each is a real v83 monster of 'Hidden Street - Path of Time' with its own MonsterBook page (no hideName copy), and each pays 0.9-1.0 times level_curve.json exp at its level. Gatekeeper and Thanatos are the bosses of maps 1 and 2 and are in no pool. Papulatus is scheduled as the clock 8500001, which revives into the flying form 8500002 (its native Origin of Clocktower is 1190 x 594 and empty, so both fight in Deep Inside the Clocktower).

boss._tier: tier C (#472): first draft of level_scale_draft.gd --step=15 --stage=clocktower, not tuned: arrives at curve time 300 (E_sw 10.80, level 40.80); attack1 (type 0, physical, PADamage 600) and attack2 (type 0, magic, lightning, the mob's MADamage 600) tie at 600, so the tool matches attack1 on PAD; 8 s cadence. Gatekeeper is a plain unflagged v83 mob (78000 HP, speed -50). Its kit is Stun 123/1 (B1: after a stun ends it cannot apply again for the status_lockout floor of 4 s) as written in Skill.wz

tier C (#472): first draft of level_scale_draft.gd --step=15 --stage=clocktower, not tuned: arrives at curve time 600 (E_sw 36.44, level 66.44); attack1 (type 3: nine warned ground columns, five struck per cast, magic, ice, the mob's MADamage 620) is matched on MAD; 8 s cadence. Its kit runs as written in Skill.wz: Poison 125/1 (B4), Curse 124/1 and Darkness 121/1 (B3); Seal 120/1 is skipped (not a supported MobSkill, the known skip)

tier C (#472): first draft of level_scale_draft.gd --step=15 --stage=clocktower, not tuned: arrives at curve time 900 (E_sw 56.85, level 86.85); the clock's four type-0 strikes (all magic, lightning, ice and fire, the mob's MADamage 480) are matched on MAD; 8 s cadence. The 23,000,000 HP clock (x 0.038) and the 1,590,000 HP flying form (x 0.546, final_form_hp_mult, 0.5 of the encounter each) share the survivor HP target; the form is matched at the clock's arrival level, so at runtime its HP lands above target. The clock's attack3 effect0 random secondary strikes are skipped (not modelled as extra strikes). Its kit runs as written in Skill.wz: Dispel 127/1 (B6, 20 s floor), Slow 126/1, heal 114/4, Stun 123/4 (B1, interval 1 so the status_lockout floor applies) and the Low and High Darkstar summons 200/39 and 200/40 (self-destructing, StageRoster). The flying form 8500002 (B6) has no attack stance and fights by touch (PADamage 800, MADamage 1000)

_level_scale: Tier C (#472, #449 first draft): pasted from level_scale_draft.gd --step=15 --stage=clocktower, not tuned. exp_level(t) is Sleepywood's effective level E_sw at each keyframe time, and level(t) = E_sw(t) + 3 x (15 - 5), so every region levels the character at Sleepywood's pace and this step is thirty effective levels harder. The draft raised no warning (the highest level, 86.85, is below the 131 where the reference curves go flat). Without it the stage would run its canonical monsters at full strength from 0:00 for a Lv1 character.
_pools: Tier C weights (#472). Map 1, on the keyframes under 300 s: the lower Path of Time's Ghost Pirate 7140000 (Lv83), Death Teddy 7130010 (Lv85) and Dual Ghost Pirate 7160000 (Lv87). The opening is the two weaker mobs, 3 : 2, and the Dual Ghost Pirate joins at 120 s on equal weights (2 : 2 : 2). Maps 2 and 3 use explicit pools at the spawn-point ratios of the Path of Time maps that hold each mob (Master Death Teddy 15, Spirit Viking 14, Phantom Watch 26; Gigantic Spirit Viking 26, Grim Phantom Watch 14), because the passages' own life lists are only the bosses.
note: The lost passages of the Ludibrium Clocktower. Defeat the Gatekeeper, Thanatos and Papulatus.
